a: al-Baghdādī al-Ḥātamī, Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Muẓaffar (922–998)
Mutanabbī, Abū al-Ṭayyib Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥusayn (915 or 916-965)
5d77e5e4-ed5e-4319-a11f-0a09e555f484.f: Biblioteca Universitaria di Bologna. Fondo manoscritti, mss. 2949 - 3475
5d77e5e4-ed5e-4319-a11f-0a09e555f484.c:
Multi-text manuscript.
A miscellany of short texts in prose and poetry.
ff. 1v-15v: Turkish title (by a different hand from the main text) نور الدين زاده قدس سره حضرتلرينك خط شريفلردر by Nuraddin Zadah.
ff. 15v-21r: الرسالة الحاتمية, by Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Muẓaffar al-Baghdādī al-Ḥātamī on the philosophy of Aristotle and of Abū al-Ṭayyib Aḥmad b. al-Ḥusayn al-Mutanabbī.
ff. 21r-v: A prayer (duʿāʾ) attributed to Alexander the Two-Horned, entitled دعاء يُنسب إلى الإسكندر.
ff. 21v-22r: A letter of ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb to Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī, entitled كتاب أمير المؤمنين عمر بن الخطاب.
f. 22v: A short untitled Arabic text on the 99 names of Allah.
f. 23r: A red-and-black circular diagram, with the title at the centre: الدائرة الربانية.

;

Ms. is lacunose and mutilated of the final folio
The date is on folio 15v.
Marginal corrections.
Calligraphic naskh, partially vocalized.
Titles, rubrics, punctuation, and overlinings in red.
The coat of arms of Ferdinando Marsili is stamped in gold on the front and back covers.
